The transmission inner function changes its flow expression from `var.loc[:, idx] * efficiency[idx]` to `var.loc[:, idx] * -efficiency.sel(name=idx)`, explicitly reversing the sign. For a branch with nonzero flow and nonzero port efficiency, this produces a different value even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, since the sign change is unconditional.
